item.title: A Tricky Plein Air Study
item.description: Here’s a little plein air study I did recently. Don’t judge too harshly! This was a tricky subject and challenging conditions. The water chopped and churned against the shore, and gradually receded with the outgoing tide. The light came and went based on the clouds.
